text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate of AC capacity in MW. Line: 80% range from resampling whole months, divided by the recovery of known farms. Grey dashed line: the capacity pinned by experiment 45's earlier method, a control and not a truth. Primaries D5, D10, D11, D14, D16.'
text.tspan: Dot: estimate of AC capacity in MW. Line: 80% range from resampling whole months, divided by the
recovery of known farms. Grey dashed line: the capacity pinned by experiment 45's earlier method, a
control and not a truth. Primaries D5, D10, D11, D14, D16.
